title: All day schedule: LIT + the two evening setups positive everywhere (peeked)
question: Owner 2026-10-23: start trading 24/7 - which setups work in each part of the NQ day, at the same or a higher win rate than LIT?
verdict: LIT size, costs in, LIT first. H1 112 trades (4.38/wk), win 54.5% (clean >= +0.5R 28.6%), PF 3.0, net +37,102 ($6,087/mo), DD -3,214. H2 70 trades (4.49/wk), win 44.3% (clean >= +0.5R 35.7%), PF 2.12, net +16,125 ($4,341/mo), DD -2,766. 2025 net +5,689, 2021-24 net +29,839. LIT alone H1 +33,891 / H2 +9,493. On LIT's 50K eval (two_week, extras at half the need size, LIT priority): 2-week pass/fail H1 52.9/4.2, H2 52.2/5.8 (LIT alone 57.1/5.9, 52.2/0.0).
notes: tools/allday.py combo / save; LIT trades = run lit_live (1m entries in 2026, 5m before)
method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
